messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] dedpool node alert — pool=deepwell-az1 node=gpu3 severity=high: BMC firmware CRC mismatch, ECC spikes, GPU temps throttling, auto-drain initiated. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.
Anya (oncall): Acked. Paging infra and SRE. Assigning incident lead.
Paul (SRE): I'm taking the lead. Any customer-facing errors yet? Which tenants on gpu3?
DeepWell Ops: Seeing increased 5xxs and "timeout reading kv-cache" in our app logs 2m ago. Traffic routed through deepwell-az1. Confirm affected dedicated pool = deepwell-az1 (vpc: prod-deepwell).
Taylor (AE): Confirmed DeepWell on the phone, they see request failures and degraded latency. They asked for ETA — currently unknown.
Mike (infra): On it. Looking at node: bmc reports corrupt firmware image, host kernel has repeated AER/NVME I/O errors, nvidia-smi shows intermittent device disappear.
Paul (SRE): Ok — immediate priorities: 1) confirm tenant isolation, 2) evacuate tenants off gpu3, 3) failover traffic to reserved warm nodes, 4) avoid full pool drain if can live-migrate.
Anya (oncall): @Mike please run the drain runbook for dedicated pools. Use graceful eviction first, fall back to force if pods stuck.
Mike (infra): Running: \n```\n/drain-node --pool deepwell-az1 --node gpu3 --mode graceful --timeout 10m\n```\nIf pods don't terminate within 10m we'll escalate to force. Starting now.
DeepWell Ops: We see some jobs pinned to that node (long-running batch). Can you coordinate migration?
Paul (SRE): We'll cordon and migrate. For batch jobs we'll request the app team to checkpoint; if not possible we'll spin ephemeral replacements in reserved capacity.
Taylor (AE): If this takes >30m DeepWell wants a status update and possible SLA credit assessment. Please log timeline and impacted requests count.
Anya (oncall): Noted. Paul, please capture current errors/percentiles and token-by-token request failures for post-incident analysis.
Mike (infra): Graceful drain in progress: 3/12 GPU tasks migrated, 5 still draining, 4 blocked by zfs locks. For blocked jobs sending SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 30s.
Paul (SRE): Applying tenant isolation policy: ban new allocations on gpu3 and route allocation requests to warm-reserve pool (policy set: prefer=warm-deepwell-1). Updating routing now.
Mike (infra): BMC flash attempt scheduled but can't write due to IO errors. Opening hardware ticket with colo. RMA standby prepared.
DeepWell Ops: We've staged a reduced traffic mode on our side (circuit-breaker) to reduce loss while you migrate — thanks.
Paul (SRE): Rolling mitigation: 1) isolate node, 2) migrate critical tenants, 3) divert new allocations, 4) if migration fails, evict and restart on reserve.
Anya (oncall): Can infra confirm fallback model/memory of KV cache preserved? We need to know if customers will see cold cache.
Mike (infra): KV cache is not preserved on forced eviction — expect cold-cache. We are preparing to warm caches on reserve nodes with prioritized traffic buckets.
Taylor (AE): I'll relay that to DeepWell: they should expect cold-cache for affected endpoints for a few minutes.
Paul (SRE): 20m update: drain complete for user-facing services; 2 batch jobs still stuck — we killed and restarted them on reserve. Error rate down 63% overall.
DeepWell Ops: Errors dropped substantially, main endpoints back to normal. We still see a handful of 500s on /embed endpoint.
Mike (infra): BMC firmware rewrite failed locally — moving to RMA; cordoned gpu3 permanently. We'll mark node for replacement and re-provision a new node in deepwell-az1 via spare inventory.
Anya (oncall): Action items logged: infra to RMA node, SRE to draft incident summary, AE to notify customer SLA team if requested. Postmortem owners: Paul (SRE) + Mike (infra).
Taylor (AE): DeepWell accepts initial mitigation. Requested written timeline and impact numbers within 2 hours.
Paul (SRE): I'll create incident ticket INC-4212345678 and attach logs + metrics + eviction timeline.
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] incident status=mitigated — customer-facing services restored for DeepWell. Node gpu3 cordoned and scheduled for RMA.
Anya (oncall): Moving to monitoring state. If anything spikes reopen. Good job team.
DeepWell Ops: Thanks team — we'll validate at our end and follow up on any residual errors.
Paul (SRE): Post-incident follow-ups: 1) investigate why BMC firmware corrupt image wasn't caught by preflight, 2) add health-check to detect nvlink/ecc spikes earlier, 3) improve live-evacuation for long-running batches.
Mike (infra): I'll pull serial logs and send to hw vendor. Also adding an automated pre-check to our pool onboarding job.
Taylor (AE): I'll collect customer impact metrics and confirm any SLA remediation.
Anya (oncall): Closing thread to operational updates — keep notes in INC-4212345678. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
